notes.text:
Palo Alto Networks has published [1] information on a vulnerability in PAN-OS related to the Brotli vulnerability. This advisory lists the related Siemens Industrial products affected by this vulnerability.  

Customers are advised to consult and implement the workarounds provided in Palo Alto Networks' upstream security notifications.

[1] https://security.paloaltonetworks.com/CVE-2026-111497
notes.title: Summary

notes.text:
As a general security measure, Siemens strongly recommends to protect network access to devices with appropriate mechanisms. In order to operate the devices in a protected IT environment, Siemens recommends to configure the environment according to Siemens' operational guidelines for Industrial Security (Download: https://www.siemens.com/cert/operational-guidelines-industrial-security), and to follow the recommendations in the product manuals.
Additional information on Industrial Security by Siemens can be found at: https://www.siemens.com/industrialsecurity
notes.title: General Recommendations

notes.text: For further inquiries on security vulnerabilities in Siemens products and solutions, please contact the Siemens ProductCERT: https://www.siemens.com/cert/advisories

revision_history.summary: Changed "Node2Shell Vulnerability" to "Brotli Vulnerability"; added Mitigation; clarified version details

product.name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS VM-Series >= V11.2.10 < V11.2.10-h17 with Brotli inspection & TLS/SSL decryption enabled

full_product_name.name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS VM-Series installed on RUGGEDCOM APE1808

notes.text: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.
notes.title: CVE Description

remediations.details: set system setting brotli-encoding disable (CLI, 11.2.4+), or clear Allow Brotli Encoding under Device > Setup > Content-ID and commit (web UI, 12.1.2+)
Contact customer support to receive additional patch and update information.
